page.notes: Marginal notes: right margin, beside the lines "Cùm igitur sic se res habeat" and "tionem &justitiam imputatam esse nobis, nos-". The first note "*fatisfactio-nem." is at the "*" after "Christi"; the second, "†nempe par-tam morte Christi.", is at the "†" after "&". The text ends at "nos-" (hyphen at line end), so the page is cut off there, with no catchword. The paragraph breaks are not clearly marked by indentation; the text is continuous, so it is set as one paragraph. Some long s are read as plain s per the rules; the printed forms show "f"-like long s in "esse", "dixisset", etc. Doubtful: "peßimum" (read as "pessimum"), and the reference "†" in "&†justitiam" is uncertain.
